implementation.byoInvites: Share is the primary post-create action using server share_url; Create another is subordinate. The UI displays server expires_at and each returned invite status with server created_at. Open-invite cancellation requires confirmation. No token reconstruction or fee calculation change.
implementation.businessStaff: Owner-wide scope is explicit; current and inactive members retain stable member IDs and show role-specific rights. Remove access requires confirmation naming the member and owner. UUID-only add remains.
implementation.businessContext: Membership business_id is passed as shopId or venueId; owner_id is passed as ownerId. Provider navigation retains providerId. Route context never replaces server authorization.
implementation.shopEnquiriesAndRfqs: Existing authorized lists are filtered by their returned shop_id. Unscoped lists are labelled All businesses. Manage shop navigation retains ownerId/shopId.
implementation.merchantShop: Selected context uses the existing owner-aware getMyShop(ownerId) read and is checked against returned owner/shop IDs. Existing business_role read-only behavior and owner-only product editing remain.
implementation.sports: Initial venueId is resolved only against the authorized server-returned venue list; unavailable selection remains empty and visibly reports the unavailable request. Manual selection also rejects IDs outside that list.
implementation.identityAndFlags: protectedInvite retains its existing useBrandIdentity('protectedInvite') consumer. RFQ identity uses useBrandIdentity('rfq') independently from oorva_business_staff_ux. Business presentation requires the effective oorva_brand parent and oorva_business_staff_ux leaf; no flag is enabled.
